learned: 2026-10-05, by an agent pass: six single-strain rosin gummy flavors, one Squarespace page each, linked from the homepage. No shop or product feed. One page serves every state; the NY COA reports (/ny-coa-reports) cover all six flavor codes (mg, gv, pa, gf, ks, pf).
notes: The flavor pages are listed by hand in source.urls: the homepage cards (article.Index-gallery-item) link to them, and a new flavor needs adding here.

Each page states the dose per state group: 'AZ, CA, CO, IL, MA, MO, NJ, NM, NV, NY, OR, WA | 10mg THC per gummy, 100mg per package', and 'MI | 20mg ... 200mg'. The ratio flavors write each cannabinoid ('10mg THC:10mg CBD:10mg CBC per gummy, 100mg THC:100mg CBD:100mg CBC per package'); the size is the THC, as stores list it. The title rule applies only when NY is in the 10mg THC / 100mg group, so a dose change for New York falls through to unparsed rather than writing a wrong size; a page with no NY at all is skipped as not sold here.
Three flavors are 1:1:1 ratio gummies: Grapefruit THC:CBD:CBC, Kiwi Strawberry THC:CBD:CBG, Passion Fruit THC:CBD:CBN. The flavor still names the product.

The line is the flavor's effect word, the first h3 on the page ('UPLIFTING'), as stores write 'Uplifting Pineapple' / 'Mellow Mango'; the strain is the flavor, from the page title 'Pineapple | Good Tide'. The effect comes out upper case, as the site writes it.
